input.summary: Add a 90-day deliverable conformance warranty with re-performance/repair/replacement/refund remedy, and renumber the disclaimer.
input.comment: [Playbook] Section 5 contains no conformance warranty or remedy for defective work, so we added a 90-day warranty that Deliverables conform to their Specifications and documentation, backed by re-performance, repair, replacement or refund. This is our standard position; we can discuss a shorter cure window if the remedy is preserved.

ops.text: (e) Contractor represents and warrants that the Services will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner consistent with industry standards, and that, for a period of ninety (90) days following delivery, each deliverable and Work will conform in all material respects to the applicable Specifications and its documentation. Company's remedy for breach of this warranty is, at Contractor's option, re-performance, repair or replacement of the non-conforming Services, deliverable or Work, or a refund of the fees paid for the non-conforming Services, deliverable or Work.

ops.oldText: (e) THE EXPRESS WARRANTIES IN THIS AGREEMENT
ops.newText: (f) THE EXPRESS WARRANTIES IN THIS AGREEMENT
